title: The Hollywood Roosevelt: Fabulous Baker Boys Hotel Guide
description: The Hollywood Roosevelt hosted the first Academy Awards in 1929 and features in The Fabulous Baker Boys. History, Marilyn Monroe and booking tips.
h1: The Hollywood Roosevelt: where the first Oscars were held
intro: Across from the TCL Chinese Theatre, the Hollywood Roosevelt is a Hollywood Boulevard landmark with an unusually good origin story: it hosted the very first Academy Awards.
filming: The hotel has been a screen location for decades. The famous piano scene in The Fabulous Baker Boys (1989) was shot in its Cinegrill nightclub, and its poolside has appeared in productions including I Love Lucy, Almost Famous and Entourage.
facts: The hotel opened in 1927 and was backed by Hollywood figures including Douglas Fairbanks, Mary Pickford, Sid Grauman and Louis B. Mayer.
The first Academy Awards were held in its Blossom Ballroom on May 16, 1929, with about 270 guests and no broadcast.
Wings won the first Best Picture award, and a poster for the film still hangs on the hotel's lower level.
Marilyn Monroe lived in a second-floor cabana overlooking the pool for two years and shot her first print ad at the hotel.
The hotel is named after President Theodore Roosevelt.
visit: Ask about poolside rooms with a view of the Tropicana Pool. Hollywood Boulevard's attractions are within walking distance.
